_readme: Hand-counted text areas per bench page. Promoted out of the prose table in
docs/region_threshold_validation_2026-08-08.md §2-3 so tooling can assert on it.
'count' is a by-eye count of text areas, taken from the human reference translation where
one exists and from the source page otherwise. It is NOT an annotated box set -- 'boxes'
is the slot for that and is null everywhere today.
Two counts are +/-1 judgement calls (see 'caveat'). No metric derived from this file should
be read to better than +/-1 per page, and no threshold should be chosen on a 1-region margin.

_schema.count: int -- hand-counted text areas on the page
_schema.source: 'human' (counted off the reference translation) | 'source-page' (counted off the raw page)
_schema.notes: why the count is what it is
_schema.caveat: present only where the count is a judgement call; explains the ambiguity
_schema.boxes: null, or a list of [x, y, w, h] in page.webp pixel space once annotated

_counts_differ_on_purpose: 'count' counts text areas visible on the page. 'annotated_groups' counts balloons that got at
least one PaddleOCR fragment. A text area OCR missed entirely has no fragments to group, so
annotated_groups <= count is normal and is a measure of DETECTION loss, not merge quality.
annotated_groups > count is NOT normal -- it means the annotation split something the count
treats as one area, or a non-text detection was grouped instead of excluded. Both cases are
currently resolved; if this ever reappears, look for a false-positive fragment first.

sample3.notes: 8 balloons + the DCG Corporation name badge. YOLO returns 4 bubbles for these 9 balloons because they visually touch.

sample1.notes: Machine TL only, no human reference. Unambiguous.

sample30.notes: Strongest confirmation page: at <=0.35 the 7 regions map 1:1 onto the 7 balloons, verified against the art rather than by count. 4 YOLO bubbles, 0 unmatched fragments.

sample16.notes: Never reaches truth at any threshold -- plateaus at 9. The gap is a detector miss, not a merge effect. Fragment 0 is a hair clip that PaddleOCR read as an ideograph at confidence 0.145 -- excluded from the annotation, not grouped.

sample9.notes: Dense 4-panel page. Never reaches truth; plateaus at 15. Gap is one undetected SFX plus two balloons whose text merges with an adjacent sub-caption inside a single YOLO bubble.
sample9.caveat: +/-1: whether the sub-caption inside a balloon counts as its own text area. Affects two balloons.
sample9.ocr_note: Fragment 33 reads 'ご飯が進むから' (confidence 0.470) -- real text, badly recognised at fragment level. Corpus region r7 already carries the correct string but is tiered 'unresolved'; it can be promoted to gold.

sample27.notes: Dense 4-panel page, and the only page that over-splits (20 at <=0.5).
sample27.caveat: +/-1: whether panel 3's two column groups sit in one balloon. Separately, the panel-2 borderless shout is split across the bubble path and the unmatched path, so its two halves never meet in the same merge call -- NO grouping configuration can join them. Exclude that region from any ship-gate arithmetic or the gate is unsatisfiable.
sample27.ocr_note: Fragment 5 (corpus region r13) is transcribed 'ユキ' at confidence 0.403 but is visually the SFX ト干, rendered 'ba-dump' in the human reference. Real content, correctly kept as its own group -- and the reason a confidence floor cannot be set above ~0.40: stylised SFX score low by nature.

sample23.notes: Control page: 0 YOLO bubbles, so the in-bubble threshold never executes and the count must stay constant across an in-bubble sweep. All 61 fragments are horizontal (avg 214x33, 61/61 wider than tall); merging as 'ltr' gives exactly 17 stably across ratio 0.25-1.0, while the 'rtl' vertical assumption collapses it to 2.
